capabilities: Manage tasks with statuses, types, comments, image attachments and due dates
Plan each day with a Today focus list, carry-over and end-of-day review
Draw Gantt timelines per note with prerequisites, lag, milestones and critical path
Mirror tasks into linked notes as synced checkbox lines
Export timelines as PDF, PNG, SVG or clipboard image
extras: Data lives in the plugin's own data.json, so it travels with Obsidian Sync; daily backups with a restore command are built in. The optional Claude morning suggestion is the only online feature and is off until the user adds their own Anthropic API key; everything else works offline. Includes unrelated extras such as a recipe-scaling ratio code block and a work-history view.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track tasks with statuses and comments in one place or to schedule project notes on a timeline.

relations.evidence: Optional morning suggestion from Claude. Off until you add your own Anthropic API key

summary: Task manager with statuses, comments and images, a daily Today focus view, and per-note Gantt timelines with dependencies and critical path.
